w:r.w:t: OptiFleet Mobile Application is a comprehensive fleet management solution developed by NeoGeoInfo Technologies Limited to manage and monitor fleet operations efficiently. It enables organizations to manage users, drivers, vehicles, devices, associations, and trips through a secure mobile platform. The application provides Real-Time GPS vehicle tracking, live fleet monitoring, and trip management with role-based access for Admin, User, and Driver. It continuously monitors vehicle location, speed, and driving behaviour by detecting events such as Overspeed, smoking, Mobile Usage, drowsiness, route deviation, harsh braking, harsh acceleration, and rash turning. It also provides vehicle details, driver scorecards, safety scores, notifications, and operational insights, helping organizations improve fleet visibility, enhance driver safety, optimize operational efficiency, and support informed decision-making.

Provides secure authentication with dedicated access for Admin, User, and Driver roles. Each role is granted specific permissions to ensure secure access to fleet information and application features while protecting operational data.

Displays real-time fleet statistics, including active and idle vehicles, active drivers, live alerts, the live fleet map, trip information, and organization-level summaries. The dashboard enables users to monitor fleet operations and quickly identify important events.

Generates driver scorecards and safety scores based on driving behaviour, safety events, and distance travelled. These scorecards help organizations evaluate driver performance, identify areas for improvement, and encourage safe driving practices.

The system stores detailed information about vehicles such as registration number, engine details, and insurance data. It also integrates real-time tracking information, enabling users to view live location, speed, and operational status of each vehicle

Driver ManagementThis module manages driver information including name, license details, phone number, and identity verification. The system validates all inputs, including uploaded pictures, and ensures that only verified drivers are assigned to vehicles and trips.

Association ManagementThe system links vehicles, devices, and drivers to create a complete operational mapping. Admins first assign devices to vehicles, and then users link drivers to these vehicles, ensuring that tracking data is accurately mapped to real-world entities.

Trip ManagementUsers can create and manage trips by assigning vehicles and drivers and selecting routes. The system calculates distance and duration automatically and tracks the trip status throughout its lifecycle, from start to completion.

Real-Time TrackingThe system provides live tracking of vehicles by integrating with external telemetry platforms. Users can monitor vehicle movement on a map and view Real-Time data such as speed and location updates.
Provides real-time notifications for trip activities, vehicle status updates, driver safety violations, and other important operational events, enabling users to respond quickly and efficiently.

Provides a consolidated view of organizations, users, drivers, vehicles, and connected devices. It enables administrators to monitor system resources and understand the overall status of fleet operations.

Integrates seamlessly with GPS tracking devices and IoT platforms to collect and process real-time telemetry, including vehicle location, speed, engine RPM, ignition status, signal health, timestamps, and other operational parameters, ensuring accurate and reliable fleet monitoring.

Follow the steps below to install the OptiFleet Mobile Application on your Android device:
1. Obtain the latest OptiFleet Mobile Application (APK) from your system administrator or the official distribution source.
2. Download or copy the APK file to your Android device.
3. If prompted, enable Install Unknown Apps (or Install from Unknown Sources) in your Android settings.
4. Open the downloaded APK file and tap Install.
5. Wait for the installation to complete successfully.
6. Tap Open to launch the OptiFleet Mobile Application.
7. Grant the required permissions, including Location, Notifications, and Internet, to enable all application features.
8. Sign in using your assigned Username and Password to access the application.
Note: The OptiFleet Mobile Application is currently distributed as an APK through authorized channels. Once published, it will also be available for download from the Google Play Store.

The Notifications module provides real-time event notifications generated from vehicle and driver activity during fleet operations. These notifications help users monitor important events as they occur and take appropriate action whenever required. Each notification is generated automatically when the corresponding event is detected by the connected tracking device.
Smoking | Generated when smoking activity is detected inside the vehicle.
Mobile Usage | Generated when Mobile Usage is detected while driving.
Overspeed | Generated when the vehicle exceeds the configured speed limit.
Drowsiness | Generated when driver drowsiness or fatigue is detected.
Seatbelt | Generated when the seatbelt is not detected during vehicle operation.
Distraction | Generated when driver distraction is detected.
Harsh Braking | Generated when sudden or excessive braking is detected.
Harsh Acceleration | Generated when rapid acceleration is detected.
Rash Turning | Generated when sharp or unsafe turning is detected.
Yawn Alert | Generated when repeated yawning is detected during driving.

The Driver Mobile Features are designed to support drivers in efficiently managing their daily transportation activities through a simple and user-friendly mobile application. Drivers can securely log in using OTP authentication, access live trip information, monitor trip progress, and receive Real-Time notifications during vehicle operation. The application also provides notifications for events such as Smoking, Mobile Usage, Overspeed, Drowsiness, Seatbelt, Distraction, Harsh Braking, Harsh Acceleration, Rash Turning, and Yawn Alert, helping drivers stay informed about important events during their journey. By integrating GPS tracking, live telemetry, and Real-Time event monitoring, the Driver Mobile Application improves trip visibility, enhances operational efficiency, and promotes safer driving practices.
